notes.title: Dude on iOS
notes.content:
Our indie game has finally arrived on iOS, and we couldn't be more excited!

Hi, I'm Arik, the developer of Dude, Where Is My Beer? I'm happy to tell you that after three years, we got our game into the App Store and right now it’s number four game in the Adventure category in Norway! Don't forget to recommend it to your friends with iPhones :)

(The game is also available on Nintendo Switch and GOG.com)

Link to Apple Store
(It's available in English, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Spanish and Russian)

notes.title: Kickstarter pre-launch!
notes.content:
Ready to fight the Master Brewer and reveal the craft beer conspiracy?

Right now we are working on the sequel and are about to run a Kickstarter campaign. Before we click the "Launch" button, we want as many people as possible to subscribe to the campaign, so we would appreciate if you could spread the word about it. We are very happy to see that there are a lot of people who have already subscribed to the campaign. If you want to get notified when it goes live, you can click the "Notify" button here: 
http://dudewhereismybeer.com/ks
